crop_policy: Each fixed rectangle cropped once; all subsequent views use the entire saved crop, magnified or rotated only.
view_completeness: All 29 whole image outputs were visible; no truncated image result was counted as a successful view.
independence: Only the assigned scan036 source image/box list and their fixed crops were read. No first transcription, witness, other page, notes, review, comparison, or outcome was opened. No OCR, external research, or TeX compilation was used.
edge_policy: Legible overlapping text is retained; physically clipped/unreadable text is marked, and isolated edge strokes are drawn where textual identification is unavailable. No missing letters are completed from mathematical expectations.
